name: plugin.database_sql
description: Universal SQL database schema inspector, query runner, and execution plan explainer

entrypoints.name: sql_inspect_schema
entrypoints.description: Inspect all tables, columns, data types, primary keys, and row counts in a SQLite database

entrypoints.name: sql_execute_query
entrypoints.description: Execute a SQL query with read-only safety validation and result limits

parameters.name: read_only
parameters.description: Enforce read-only queries (SELECT / PRAGMA / EXPLAIN) (default: true)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 50)

entrypoints.name: sql_explain_query
entrypoints.description: Get query execution plan (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN) for a SQL statement
